_comment: Copy to config/money.json. Nothing here moves money; it tracks what you decide and does the arithmetic.
_envelopes: Percentages of the month's allocation, and they must total 100. Edit freely - these are a starting split, not advice. 'invest' is a holding envelope: the agent tracks what you put there and never tells you where to put it.

projection._assumedAnnualReturn: YOUR assumption, used only to project a savings goal forward. It is arithmetic on a number you chose, not a forecast and not a recommendation. Every projection prints this rate alongside the result.

offerModel._usdToInr: Rate you set. Update it when it drifts; every offer model prints the rate it used.
offerModel._currentAnnualTakeHomeInr: Your present take-home for the year, so an offer can be compared against something real. Fill this in from your payslips - the agent will not guess it.
offerModel._tax: Editable slabs for the Indian new regime. THIS IS A CALCULATOR, NOT TAX ADVICE - the numbers change with each budget, and a real filing has details this ignores. Check against the current finance act before making a decision on it.
